status: Historical diagnosis plan. Adjacent-tile-entry action semantics, expanded state and complete native-game evaluation are implemented. See teacher-validation-spec.json and teacher-methods.md for the current candidate/gates; qualification and new data are separately reported. Centre/substep proposals in this original plan are superseded by whole-frame adjacent-tile entry.

work: Preserve completed skills/Pac-Man checkpoints and hashes. Run the new five-seed all-life comparison on the RTX GPU.
Keep 256-snapshot agreement secondary, with safety, power, junction, revisit, late-maze and respawn denominators. Mark missing strata unavailable.
phases.gate: Both models use identical pinned v1 controller/observation/protocol and verified identities. Preserve per-seed traces and cap reasons.

work: Implement a separately versioned v2 decision boundary at the requested adjacent tile centre, checking native movement substeps so two-pixel frames cannot skip the centre.
Make immediate reversals reach the requested adjacent tile; handle off-centre spawn alignment explicitly rather than labelling it as a one-tile decision.
Preserve native speed, collisions, consumption, frightened pauses and tunnel wrapping. Benchmark records the native duration of every move.
Carry the complete ghost-release rewind fix into v2 teacher search. Never silently reinterpret v1 replay records.
phases.gate: CPU/browser parity for centre crossing, reverse, corner turn, tunnel, all level speed phases, pellet pause, ghost-eating pause, death/respawn and release-counter transition. A nonterminal one-tile action has the declared adjacent endpoint.

work: Keep full maze/pellet coordinates and named ghosts. Add explicitly versioned pixel offsets, speed-cycle phase, pending ghost heading/reversal, eat-pause state, life epoch, release counters and exact phase/power clocks obtained from native current state.
Expose elapsed moves/frames since last pellet and recent history sufficient for 24+ move cycles, plus candidate-destination visit counts or a compact coverage map.

Add auditable current-state summaries for each legal move: destination pellet/power pellet, maze distance to remaining pellets and dangerous ghosts. These are current-state features, not teacher future plans.
Bound token count and test identical formatting in training, snapshot evaluation and live inference. Keep RNG state, replay seed, label and future teacher sequence private.
phases.gate: No differing preferred label solely due to hidden current timers/pixel state within audited observation-equivalent groups. Otherwise expand observable state or use a belief-aware teacher with a documented ambiguity target. Do not call the observation fully Markov without this test.

work: Use safety before progress: reject immediately fatal actions whenever a nonfatal action exists, then rank time-to-death/survival, pellet progress, coverage and action duration.
Replace indiscriminate lifetime visit penalties with a no-progress cycle penalty; allow necessary transit through already cleared corridors.
Add a long-range remaining-pellet route objective for maze cleanup. Replan through multiple lives, ghost release transitions and power expiry.

Retain exact native ghost mechanics, approximate search provenance and independent frightened RNG scenarios. Record ties and all-horizon-die cases explicitly; do not force arbitrary exact ties into one hard label.
Compare revised teacher with old planner and heuristic on separate development episodes. Inspect fatalities, stalls, missing pellets, ghost hunts and level clears manually.
phases.gate: Predeclare development caps and safety thresholds. At minimum, obtain actual level clears and eliminate the observed multi-tile/rewind failures and reproducible long no-pellet cycles. A higher mean score with zero clears/four caps is rejected as sufficient teacher validation. Publish distributions and remaining failures before large generation.

work: Collect full trajectories of the current Kev and revised teacher on training-only seeds, including errors and respawns. Label learner-visited states with the validated teacher, then aggregate in rounds (DAgger-style).
Use the supplied seed-7 failure as a training/regression case if desired; thereafter exclude it from held-out reporting.

Balance survival-critical ghost encounters, turns out of empty corridors, junction pellet branches, maze cleanup, power acquisition/expiry/hunting and post-death release behavior. Preserve ordinary play so corrections do not become a new shortcut.
Split complete games and related native state forks together; enforce seed/episode and observable-hash separation. Reserve benchmark seeds permanently; print coverage denominators in all splits.
Generate a reviewed pilot of at most 2048 boards only after earlier gates. Grow to 8192-16384 task examples if coverage and timing justify it; count alone is not a quality gate.
phases.gate: Human inspection plus automated replay of danger, progress, power, tie and respawn examples. Reject malformed actions, unobservable labels and all-dead hard labels. Development/evaluation must contain late-maze, respawn and genuine power-expiry/ghost-eating cases.

work: Warm-start from the completed learner Skills checkpoint, keeping the faithful rank-16 all-target LoRA plus 256-dimension pointer head and decision-v7 replay architecture.
Keep published one-epoch learning-rate scale (2e-5), BF16 optimized kernels, checkpointing and effective batch eight as the reference; tune only on development data.

Measure warm training throughput, compilation/loading and maximum memory before choosing the lab dataset size. 8192+2000 replay gives 1274 updates; 16384+2000 gives 2298 updates at batch eight. Neither is claimed to fit 30 minutes without a timed GPU run.

Train independent controlled pilots to separate controller fixes, representation changes and teacher/data quality. Compare tied-target handling and critical-state weighting only with recorded development evidence.
phases.gate: No dropped/truncated records; full recipe and recovery/Drive receipts. Publish measured cost and wall time, not estimated hardware utilization as performance evidence.

work: Define a new v2 protocol for the corrected action/state semantics and evaluate BOTH the old and new checkpoint under that same version, explicitly noting the old model observation shift.

Report level clears and unresolved caps, pellet coverage, avoidable immediate deaths, no-progress cycles, first-life and post-respawn behavior, power/ghost metrics and native action geometry per seed/level.
Keep a separate expanded instructor evaluation across levels 1,2,3,5 and more seeds. Five classroom seeds on one maze do not establish broad generalization.
Use old/new snapshots only within their own version; never compare aggregate v1/v2 scores as if the task were unchanged.
phases.gate: Predeclared paired safety and progress improvement without counting censored games as wins. Inspect new failures; hold the model back if score rises while survival/progress regress.

causal_probes_before_claiming_a_shortcut: Run the same valid recorded states against the checkpoint with legal option order permuted; check action/probability stability.
Use native-valid paired trajectories/forks to isolate heading, ghost danger, pellet placement, power expiry and visit history; arbitrary inconsistent field edits are not training examples.
Compare current maze-only reasoning with an explicitly derived-feature schema on development pilots. Keep controller and labels fixed for each ablation.
